readme_summary: This repository contain only Remix's official Read the Docs documentation source code. The documentation can be found on the Remix IDE documentation site. - GitHub repo: https://github.com/remix-project-org/remix-ide/ - Website URL: https://remix-ide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ - GitHub repo: https://github.com/remix-project-org/remix-project - Website URL: https://app.remix.live - GitHub repo: https://github.com/remix-project-org/remix-website/ - Website URL: https://remix.live The **Remix Project** is a platform for development tools that use a plugin architecture. It encompasses sub-projects including Remix Plugin Engine, Remix Libraries, and of course Remix IDE. The **Remix IDE** is an open source web and desktop application. It fosters a fast development cycle and has a rich set of plugins with intuitive GUIs. Remix is used for the entire journey of contract development with Solidity
